question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP initialize request (jsonrpc 2.0, protocolVersion 2025-06-18, clientInfo public-agents-researcher 1.0), then a tools/list sent back on the session id the server issued; then the two well-known OAuth discovery paths and one keyless REST GET of simple/price for bitcoin in usd; Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream

decoded.initialize: 200, SSE; serverInfo coingecko_coingecko_typescript_api 8.1.0, where 2026-09-18 and 09-19 read 8.0.0 and 2026-09-10 read 7.1.0; protocolVersion 2025-06-18; a session id was issued and exposed through access-control-expose-headers, as on 09-18
decoded.tools-list: 200 on that session: the same two tools as 2026-09-10, 09-18 and 09-19, execute (runs JavaScript against the CoinGecko API) and search_docs. The keyless server still exposes the API through one code-execution tool rather than one tool per endpoint
decoded.challenge: none: neither the 200 nor any other response on this host carried a www-authenticate header
decoded.protected-resource-metadata: 404 at both well-known URIs, the path-aware https://mcp.api.coingecko.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp and the root form, as on 09-18 and 09-19. Nothing for an OAuth client to discover, keyless being the design
decoded.rest: GET https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin&vs_currencies=usd with no Authorization header answers 200 with a price, as on 2026-09-10, 09-18 and 09-19
decoded.compared-with-allium-the-same-day: recorded because the comparison is the reason this re-measurement was made: another keyless MCP host in this registry, mcp.allium.so, was open to a stranger at 06:31Z on 2026-09-28 and closed at 18:04Z (p-20260928-allium-mcp-gate-closed). CoinGecko's, measured at 18:23Z, had not moved

finding: With no credentials on 2026-09-28 at 18:23Z, the CoinGecko MCP host answers initialize 200 and tools/list 200 with the same two tools it listed on 2026-09-10, 09-18 and 09-19, issues a session id, sends no challenge, and answers 404 at both OAuth discovery URIs; the keyless REST price endpoint answers 200. One thing moved and it is the server's own version string, 8.1.0 where 09-18 and 09-19 read 8.0.0 and 09-10 read 7.1.0. Eighteen days after the first measurement the keyless surface is what the entry says it is. One IP is one sample, and a rate limit the vendor documents for the shared keyless pool was not reached by four requests.
